_meta.description: Structured, machine-readable decode of the user's loaded IronCAD catalogs — what each part-number prefix means, which entries actually work via InsertElement(), which parameters are real/settable, and which tool/technique to use per family. Generated from live probing (see PRODUCTION_READINESS_PLAN.md Phase 6 and ironcad-catalog-reference / ironcad-mcp-project memory), NOT guessed from names. This is a SNAPSHOT, not an API contract — re-verify with scripts/verify_catalog_manifest.py before trusting an old entry if it's been a while (catalogs can change on IronCAD/catalog updates).
_meta.brand: A German T-slot aluminum extrusion framing system (parameter names like 'Abdeckleiste'/'Dicke'/'Gesamtbreite'/'Breite'/'Hoehe' are German) — matches the Robotunits catalog naming convention.

PIL_DIST.purpose: T-slot EXTRUSION profiles ('Profil'). Name pattern PIL<w><h>SNN_ where w,h = cross-section mm.
PIL_DIST.note_no_45mm: No 45mm profile exists in this install. Closest to a 45mm drawing spec is 40x40 (PIL4040SNN_) or 50x50 (PIL5050SNN_).

length_control.inert_param: Abdeckleiste (value always 0.5, expression-driven PAR(...), NOT settable — Value/.Expression/.TryToSetExpression all fail 'Not implemented')
length_control.real_mechanism: element.GetFirstChild() ('Block' feature) -> QueryInterface(IZExtrudeFeature) -> ExtrudeDistance[0] (forward) is DIRECTLY settable to ANY length (tested 50mm-2500mm+). Wired as ironcad_set_extrude_length.
length_control.gotcha: ExtrudeDistance get is a method call ef.ExtrudeDistance(0); SET must use bracket/item syntax ef.ExtrudeDistance[0] = x. When changing direction (backward=True), the OTHER direction's slot must also be explicitly zeroed or the part ends up target+stale_length long (fixed 2026-09-24 in ironcad_set_extrude_length).

PIL_DIST.bom_naming: Name auto-updates to the real measured length on insert/cut/resize (PIL4040SNN_ -> PIL4040SNN500, PIL4040SNN420 after a cut, PIL4040SNN300 after ExtrudeDistance resize). NEVER set .Name/instance_name on a stock part meant to appear correctly in a BOM — it is destroyed permanently, does not come back even after regenerate.
PIL_DIST.rotation_recipe: Default InsertElement orientation: length runs along GLOBAL +Y. To point along +Z: rotation_deg=[0,-90,0]. To point along +X: rotation_deg=[0,-90,-90] (origin end behavior is NOT symmetric between rotations -- always re-verify extrude-forward direction via a probe bbox after rotating, don't assume it transfers from a different rotation).

cross_section_example_40x40.note: Each of the 4 faces has its own T-slot channel centered on that face. Measured via IZProfile.GetCurveIds/GetLineData on the Block feature's 2D sketch, not eyeballed. Re-derive per profile size — don't hardcode 7mm for a different width.

PIL_DIST.recommended_tool: ironcad_add_catalog_part / ironcad_build_parts for placement; ironcad_set_extrude_length for exact length.

usable_entries.FAS40xx (e.g. FAS4041, FAS4049, FAS4001,: ARTICULATING SWIVEL/HINGE JOINTS bundled with a small demo profile stub + handle/lever knob — an adjustable-angle connector, NOT a simple rigid corner gusset. Numeric suffix = profile width it's sized for (FAS40xx=40mm profile, FAS50xx=50mm, FAS16xx=16mm).

Connectors.failing_entries_note: InsertElement() fails with 'Unspecified error' — likely a folder/config node needing an interactive dialog IronCAD can't show under SilentMode. Don't retry; look for a differently-named sibling.
Connectors.standing_rule: DO NOT insert FAS*/CAP* hardware in an automated build (user's explicit instruction 2026-09-24) — IronCAD has a one-click add-on that adds correct fasteners/caps to a finished frame. Build only structural extrusions + panel/infill.

Cover_caps.purpose: Flat END CAPS for closing off an open profile end.

usable_entries.CAP4041: 40x40x4mm flat plate, exactly a cap, no fastening function. Numeric suffix = profile width.

Cover_caps.standing_rule: DO NOT insert CAP* in an automated build — see Connectors.standing_rule.

CAS_BAS.failing_entries_note: All CAS-prefixed entries fail InsertElement() ('Unspecified error', config-dialog-gated).

usable_entries.BAS4008 / BAS1020 / BAS1120 / BAS8010: Flat rectangular MOUNTING/BASE PLATES with a 2xN bolt-hole pattern (e.g. BAS4008 = 39x39mm footprint x 91.5mm) — for bolting the whole frame down to a machine/floor, NOT a corner-joint bracket.

CAS_BAS.recommended_tool: ironcad_add_catalog_part (if a floor-mount plate is actually needed; not a corner bracket substitute).

usable_entries.C4F_Form_SR / 'C4 Height adjustable' (ak: height-adjustable floor stands, sold as a PAIR — not a simple single mounting foot.

Stand.note: IZPart QI fails on these directly (Type=2 group) — would need IZAssembly/IZFeature bbox instead (see PAN_DIST notes on IZAssembly.GetBoundingBox working directly on a compound element).
Stand.recommended_tool: ironcad_add_catalog_assembly (untested on this family specifically, but same Type=2 pattern as PAN_DIST's compound entries).

PAN___P_N___.kind: GENERIC FLAT PANEL, leaf part (Type=1). Default 500x500x4mm.

settable_params.Dicke: thickness (metres) — genuinely settable via IZParameter.Value, unlike PIL's Abdeckleiste. Same underlying value as its Block->IZExtrudeFeature.ExtrudeDistance, so ironcad_set_extrude_length also works on it for thickness.

PAN___P_N___.width_height: NOT exposed as parameters on the bare entry. Custom W x H needs the Boolean tile-UNITE-then-trim-SUBTRACT recipe (see ironcad_build_panel).
PAN___P_N___.recommended_tool: ironcad_build_panel (arbitrary W x H) or ironcad_set_part_parameter/ironcad_set_extrude_length for thickness only.

PAN___P_N___+PIN4521.kind: COMPOUND catalog entry (Type=2 assembly): panel + a linked 'PIN' sizing-helper element.

settable_params.Gesamtbreite: overall width (German 'total width'). Verified settable 0.1m-2.0m live 2026-09-24 with no upper clamp found (untested beyond 2.0m).
settable_params.Gesamtlaenge: overall length ('total length'). Same range behavior as Gesamtbreite.

PAN___P_N___+PIN4521.regenerate_requirement: Setting these params requires element.QueryInterface(IZAssembly).RegenerateParts(True) to actually rebuild — a plain IZPart.Regenerate() fails (this entry mostly doesn't QI to IZPart at all) and a scene-wide regenerate does not propagate either.
PAN___P_N___+PIN4521.geometry_param_relationship: NOT a clean 1:1 — always measure the real bbox after setting+regenerating (via IZAssembly.GetBoundingBox, works directly with no child descent needed), never trust the nominal parameter value as the resulting size.
PAN___P_N___+PIN4521.auto_positioning: In the user's hand-built reference scene this part auto-positioned itself recessed into a T-slot opening once sized — the position is computed by the catalog part itself, not hand-placed (confirmed: resulting position had non-round coordinates).
PAN___P_N___+PIN4521.recommended_tool: ironcad_add_catalog_assembly with parameters={'Gesamtbreite':..., 'Gesamtlaenge':...}. Prefer this over ironcad_build_panel whenever the panel sits in a rectangular T-slot opening and the size fits this entry's range.

PAN___P_N___+CAL4515SNN___+CAN4501.kind: COMPOUND catalog entry (Type=2 assembly): panel + the REAL Robotunits panel-retention-rail (CAL4515SNN) + connector block (CAN4501) hardware — this is what the user's hand-built designs (b150004_173.ics etc.) actually use, NOT the bare PAN___P_N___ or the PIN4521 variant.

settable_params.Breite: width (German). DIFFERENT NAME from the PIN4521 family's Gesamtbreite — verified live 2026-09-24, do not assume one name set applies to both compound entries.

PAN___P_N___+CAL4515SNN___+CAN4501.regenerate_requirement: Same as PIN4521 — element.QueryInterface(IZAssembly).RegenerateParts(True) after setting params.
PAN___P_N___+CAL4515SNN___+CAN4501.geometry_param_relationship: Empirically closer to Y_span ~= 2*Breite - 0.556 in one live test (not a clean formula, not verified as general) — MEASURE the real bbox, do not compute from the param.
PAN___P_N___+CAL4515SNN___+CAN4501.real_bom_composition: Confirmed live via ironcad_list_children (recursive) on the user's real b150004_173.ics: children include CAL4515SNN____ retention-rail pieces, CAN4501 connector blocks, and the panel itself (named e.g. 'Polycarbonatglas 4-6mm PAN____P_N____' when a material has been assigned) — NOT a bare PAN___P_N___.
PAN___P_N___+CAL4515SNN___+CAN4501.recommended_tool: ironcad_add_catalog_assembly with parameters={'Breite':..., 'Hoehe':...} — THE preferred technique when matching the user's actual hand-built hardware/BOM style, not just dimensional fit.

PAN___G5N___+PIN4521.kind: sibling of PAN___P_N___+PIN4521 for a different panel-size family.
PAN___G5N___+PIN4521.settable_params: UNVERIFIED — check live before assuming Gesamtbreite/Gesamtlaenge names carry over.

PAN___G5N___+CAL4515SNN___CAN4501.kind: sibling of the CAL+CAN retention-rail entry for the G5N panel family.

CAN4501.kind: leaf connector block (~34x36x36mm), part of the CAL+CAN retention-rail system.
CAN4501.standalone_use: not typically inserted alone; appears as a child of the compound CAL+CAN entry.

CAN4503.kind: leaf connector block (~34x48x58mm), sibling of CAN4501.

CAL4515SNN____.kind: linear panel-retention rail (SNN naming matches the PIL profile convention — likely a settable-length linear part via the same GetFirstChild->IZExtrudeFeature pattern as PIL, UNVERIFIED directly, only probed as a child of the compound CAL+CAN entry so far).

panel_fit_sizing_rule.summary: When a source drawing states an exact panel size, do NOT model it at that literal dimension — resize to fit the T-slot opening.
panel_fit_sizing_rule.channel_facing_post_edge: Panel edge lands at the MIDDLE of that post's T-slot channel depth (mouth-face to back-wall, measured on the live 2D profile — 7.0mm past the face for the 40mm profile specifically; re-derive per profile width, don't hardcode).
panel_fit_sizing_rule.non_channel_facing_rail_edge: Panel edge lands exactly on the clear daylight opening (zero inset).
panel_fit_sizing_rule.why: User's explicit instruction 2026-09-23/24 — the earlier asymmetric 11.5mm/8.5mm reading from a sample file was an imprecise hand-placement artifact, not the design intent; don't reproduce that asymmetry.

MBS.purpose: Accessory inserts/adapters (front kit, slot kit, stop/flat/left/right inserts, tube/extrusion adapters) for the PIL profiles.
MBS.status: Not probed live yet — names suggest slot-fill accessories.

general_rules: A part failing InsertElement() with a bare 'Unspecified error' (not a Python/COM interface exception) generally means it's a config-dialog-gated catalog node (folder, or a part needing interactive selection) that can't be placed under SilentMode automation — don't retry, look for a differently-named sibling.

Never set .Name/instance_name on a stock/BOM catalog part (breaks auto BOM-length naming PERMANENTLY). Safe on assembly/grouping container nodes (AssembleElements groups, ironcad_connect_parts assemblies) — renaming those does not affect children's own names.

Before assuming a drawing's stated profile size (e.g. '45mm') has a catalog match, check PIL_DIST's actual stock size list — pick the closest available, note the substitution to the user, and recompute rail lengths from the drawing's real OVERALL envelope, not the nominal rail length (the profile-width delta changes how much each rail must be shortened to preserve that envelope).
